calls.title: Chris DeMars and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: GrowthBook has experienced significant growth, doubling its revenue to $8 million and securing top clients like Nistral and Salesforce. As the company moves into its next growth phase, it seeks to enhance marketing and sales efforts, supported by recent strategic hires in leadership. A developer advocate position is in progress, aimed at engaging the community and producing educational content. The advocate will operate flexibly within a flat organization of 35 employees. Chris DeMars will spearhead a conference strategy, participating in 30 global events, focusing on brand building and lead generation. The company favors a digital-first engagement approach, prompting discussions on cultural fit between Chris's travel-heavy style and the company's content generation focus.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Developer Relations, DevRel, Community Building, Conference Speaking, Content Creation
